biggest_catch: The offer code is automatically applied online when you open the account from the official Chase Secure Banking offer page — no separate email request or manual code entry is needed online.
catches: $175 bonus for a new Chase checking customer who opens a Chase Secure Banking account and completes 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days of offer enrollment; bonus appears in the account within 15 days of completing the transactions.

Qualifying transactions (per the official page): debit card purchases, Zelle, ACH credits, Chase QuickDeposit, and online bill payments. A separate official FAQ definition also counts money orders/cashier's checks and direct deposits — direct deposits count under the FAQ list but the headline list omits them, so do not rely on a single direct deposit.
$4.95 monthly service fee, $0 with $250+ in qualifying electronic deposits per statement period OR an account owner aged 17-24.
No minimum deposit to open; account subject to approval. International students and 17-year-olds must open in a branch.
The offer code is automatically applied online; do not open from a generic Chase page without confirming the offer is attached.

Eligibility detail beyond 'new Chase checking customer' (prior-account/bonus exclusions) sits in the coupon fine print not visible on the fetched public page; do not assume eligibility if you recently held or closed a Chase checking account.
Expiration and early-close/termination terms were not displayed on the fetched official page; confirm them before opening.
Taxation of the bonus is not stated on the fetched official page; bank bonuses are generally taxable, but no Chase reporting wording was captured.
Secure Banking is Chase's basic, limited checking product.
